text.p: Here are highlights from Polish newspapers this morning.
RZECZPOSPOLILTA
- KGHM copper combine will be privatised this year and its stock will be listed on the Warsaw bourse late in June or early in July, the company president Stanislaw Siewierski said.
- The Szczecin shipyard has finished construction of its first conatainer ship this year. The vessel is contracted by the Cypriot Rederei Nord Klaus E. Olendorf shipping firm.

- Telekomunikacja Polska SA (TP SA), the state-owned telecom monopolist, has acquired 810,084 new subscribers last year, a preliminary report said. The firm is now providing services to 6,538,581 subsribers.

- PZM shipping firm has contracted ten new ships to be delivered by 2000. The Szczecin shipyard will construct five container vessels, the Bulgarian Varna shipyard will produce four bulk carriers and Indonesia's Surabaya shipyard will launch a bulk carrier to be re-constructed at the Gdansk-based Stocznia Remontowa shipyard, PZM said.
- France's Soccram-Thion heat and power firm will effectively take control over the PEC heat and power plant in Kalisz, western Poland, by buying its minority stake in March or April.
- The recently passed national budget for 1997 grants a 1.28 billion zlotys subsidy for the mining sector restructuring.
- Poland's Servisco courier firm's turnover last year was 50 million zlotys, 40 percent more than in 1995, company's president L. Moritz said.
- The listed Elektrim foreign trade firm is planning to issue convertible bonds worth 550 million zlotys, Elektrim said.
NOWA EUROPA

- The general shareholders meeting of the Krakow-based Wawel confectionery, which is planning to go private this year, has decided not to issue rights shares, Wawel's president Wladyslaw Kaczmarek said.
- The National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 11 is planning to call a tender for its 33 percent stake in the Rejowiec SA cement plant in eastern Poland, the Fund said.
- The Warsaw-based Bank Ochrony Srodowiska (BOS) Environmental Protection Bank will be listed on the Warsaw bourse's main market on February 3, the bourse said in a statement.
GAZETA WYBORCZA
- Poland's customs and border tax revenues reached 28.36 million zlotys in 1996, the Main Customs Office (GUC) said.
- France's Leclerc retail chain wants to build a trading centre in the eastern city of Lublin. The construction is to start in the spring this year.
ZYCIE
- The annual net loss of the Octava National Investment Fund No. 8 reached 36.3 million zloty in 1996, the Fund said.
- Poland's construction firms are being discriminated against as foreign investors are granted better operating conditions, the Polish parliament's construction committee.
